s.action: Make a snake with your hand and wiggle it: sssss.
s.tip: Keep it a long hiss: “sssss.” No “suh.”

a.action: Pretend to bite a big apple: a, a, apple.
a.tip: The short a in apple and ant, not the letter name.

t.action: Tap a tennis ball on your racket: t, t, t.
t.tip: A quiet, quick tap of the tongue: /t/. Not “tuh.”

p.action: Pop bubbles with one finger: p, p, p.
p.tip: A quick whispered puff: /p/. Hold her hand in front of her mouth to feel it.

i.action: Scratch your arm: i, i, itchy!
i.tip: The short i in igloo and pig. Keep it short.

n.cue: Tongue up, hum through your nose
n.action: Touch your nose and hum: nnnnn.
n.tip: Tongue up behind the top teeth, sound comes out the nose: “nnnn.”

d.action: Play a drum on the table: d, d, d.
d.tip: Like /t/ but with voice on. Quick: /d/, not “duh.”

o.action: Open wide for the doctor: o, o, o.
o.tip: The short o in octopus and dog, like “ah.”

g.cue: Back of the tongue, voice on
g.action: Gulp some water: g, g, g.
g.tip: Made in the back of the mouth with voice: /g/. Quick, no “guh.”

c.action: Pretend to cough softly: c, c, c.
c.tip: c usually says /k/, a quick whisper made in the back of the mouth.

k.action: Kick a ball: k, k, kick!
k.tip: Same sound as c: /k/. k is the “kicking k.”

e.cue: Little smile, jaw drops a bit
e.action: Crack an egg on a bowl: e, e, egg.
e.tip: The short e in egg and bed. Many children mix up e and i; exaggerate your mouth.

u.action: Push an umbrella up: u, u, up!
u.tip: The short u in up and umbrella: a relaxed “uh.”

r.cue: Lips a little round, tongue back
r.tip: A growly “rrrr” with lips a little round. If she says /w/, that is common. Model it, don’t drill it.

h.action: Pant like a puppy after running: h, h, h.
h.tip: Just a breath: /h/. Hold a hand to feel the air.

b.action: Bounce a ball: b, b, b.
b.tip: Like /p/ but with voice on. Quick /b/, no “buh.” b starts with the line: bat, then ball.

f.action: Blow like a fish making bubbles: fffff.
f.tip: Gently bite the bottom lip and blow: “ffff.”

l.tip: Tongue tip up behind the top teeth: “llll.”

j.action: Jump in place: j, j, jump!
j.tip: A quick /j/ as in jump. Lips push forward a little.

w.action: Wave your hand: w, w, wave.

v.cue: Top teeth on lip, voice on
v.tip: Like /f/ with voice on. It should tickle the lip: “vvvv.”

x.cue: Kiss of air at the end
x.action: Swish a fox tail: ks, ks.
x.tip: x usually says /ks/ at the end of words: fox, box, six.

y.action: Play a yo-yo: y, y, y.
y.tip: A quick /y/ as in yes. Not the letter name.

z.tip: Like /s/ with voice on: a buzzing “zzzz.”

qu.action: Quack like a duck: qu, qu, quack!
qu.tip: q always comes with u: “qu” says /kw/.

ck.tip: Two letters, one sound: /k/. ck comes at the end of short words right after the vowel: duck, sock.

sh.cue: Lips push out, finger to lips
sh.action: Finger to lips: shhh, the baby is sleeping.

ch.action: Move arms like a train: ch, ch, choo!
ch.tip: Two letters, one quick sound: /ch/ as in chick.

th.action: Thumbs up and blow: th, th.
th.tip: Tongue peeks between the teeth. It is quiet in thumb and voiced in this and that.

wh.action: Make a whale spout with your hands: wh, wh!
wh.tip: wh says /w/ in words like when, whale, which.

ng.cue: Hum in your nose, back of tongue
ng.tip: The sound at the end of ring and king. It is one sound made in the nose.

nk.tip: nk sounds like “ng” plus /k/: wink, pink, honk.

decks.name: S
decks.cue: Smile, teeth together, tongue tip behind the top teeth. Blow a long snake sound.

decks.name: Z
decks.cue: Same mouth as /s/, then turn on your voice motor. Buzz like a bee. Touch your throat to feel it hum!

decks.name: R
decks.cue: Lips a little round, tongue pulled back, tip up but not touching anything. Growl like a tiger.

decks.name: L
decks.cue: Tongue tip up on the bump behind the top teeth. Let the sound flow around the sides: la la la.

decks.name: TH
decks.cue: Tongue tip peeks out between the teeth. Blow gently. No biting!

decks.name: SH
decks.cue: Lips push out like a square, teeth close together. Shh, the baby is sleeping.

decks.name: CH
decks.cue: Lips push out, tongue tip pops off the top. Choo-choo like a train.

decks.name: J
decks.cue: Same mouth as /ch/, then turn on your voice. Jump, jump, jump!

decks.name: K
decks.cue: Tongue tip down behind the bottom teeth, back of the tongue goes up. A quiet cough: k-k-k.

decks.name: G
decks.cue: Same mouth as /k/, then turn on your voice. Gulp like a frog: g-g-g.

decks.name: F
decks.cue: Top teeth rest gently on the bottom lip. Blow like a cat hissing: fff.

decks.name: V
decks.cue: Same mouth as /f/, then turn on your voice. Your lip tickles: vvv.

decks.name: S-blend
decks.cue: Start with a long snake sound, then slide into the next sound: sss-tar, star.

decks.name: L-blend
decks.cue: Say both sounds: p...lane, then push them together: plane. Keep the /l/ tongue up.

decks.name: R-blend
decks.cue: Say both sounds: t...rain, then push them together: train.
